versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this version.

- No changes detected; functionality and documentation remain the same as previous version.

- Initial release of the TCM Biomedical Research Strategist skill.
- Provides complete, methodological research plans for herbal medicine/TCM molecular mechanism studies targeting diseases.
- Structured outputs include 11 mandatory sections (from scientific question to feasibility assessment) for each research plan.
- Focuses on computational and network pharmacology studies, triggered by user-provided research directions.
- Includes strict scope rules, input validation, and a detailed disclaimer clarifying non-clinical use.
